_comment: Guided tour for the File tools hub (emtk app gui/app.py; the Qt hub reads it too). Targets are the hub's own rects by name: the navigation entries nav_<role>, the search field, the description strip and the panel box. The converter step waits for the user to open one.

steps.title: One hub, one kind of work
steps.text: Everything in this window acts on a file: it moves a measurement between containers, reads one back, or corrects a header. No panel here measures anything — the analyses live elsewhere on purpose.

steps.title: The converters move, they do not change
steps.text: TTTR Split / Convert, TTTR → Time Windows and ⇄ .pto all rewrite a recording into a different container. Conversion never touches the photons — if a count comes out different afterwards, the header was wrong, not the conversion.

await.hint: Open TTTR Split / Convert in the list.

steps.title: What the open tool does
steps.text: The strip above the panel says what the selected tool is for; the panel below it is that tool, unchanged — its own Guide and Help work as in its own window, and a file dropped on the hub goes to it.

steps.title: Inspect before you trust
steps.text: PTO Inspector reads what a .pto actually contains, and the TTTR header editor shows the tags a vendor wrote — the ones every later step takes on faith. Wrong micro-time card, wrong resolution, wrong detector number: this is where those are caught.

steps.title: Find a tool
steps.text: The filter matches the tools' names and descriptions.

steps.title: One broken tool breaks one panel
steps.text: Panels load lazily and independently, so a tool whose dependencies are missing shows an error here, with Retry, and the rest of the hub still works. If a panel fails to open, the problem is that tool's — not the file you dropped on another one.
